First day: new hires arrive at nine o'clock and collect their laptop and access card from the IT service desk on the second floor.

Onboarding buddy: each new hire is paired with an onboarding buddy from their own team for the first ninety days.

Benefits enrollment: health insurance enrollment must be completed in the benefits portal within thirty days of the start date.

Probation period: the probation period lasts six months, with a formal review meeting with the manager at the end of month three.
